name: Deep Knowledge
text: As an additional cost to play Deep Knowledge, add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. Investigators at your location draw a combined total of 3 cards (you decide how many cards each investigator draws).
text_cn: 作为打出深沉知识的额外费用，加入2个[curse]标记到混乱袋。 你所在地点的调查员抽取总计3张卡牌(由你决定每位调查员各抽取几张卡牌)。
